Maya Li: Following the PM notes — we need concrete owners and short ETAs for the postmortem actions on the redis connection leak. Please add JIRA links and RACI here by EOD.

Anya Petrov: I'll own the deploy gating and the canary ramp changes. Will create ticket and add acceptance criteria.

Anya Petrov: Created RED-33002 (canary ramp + gates). Link: https://jira.redwood/RED-33002. R=Anya, A=Anya, C=Carlos, I=EngOps
ops-bot: Postmortem saved: https://postmortems.redwood/4918270000
Maya Li: Please add short acceptance criteria. Example for RED-33001:
- unit + integration tests added
- staging stress run < 1% connection leak over 6h
- PR + perf logs attached
Carlos Ruiz: Added tests and perf artifacts to RED-33001. ETA proposals:
- RED-33001 due +3 days
- RED-33002 due +4 days
Anya Petrov: Added gating checklist to RED-33002 and included rollback steps. Will request @Maya review for signoff.
Maya Li: OK. Quick RACI check confirmed. I'll run a 48h checkpoint after RED-33001 lands. If anyone hits scope creep, update the ticket and ping here. :thumbsup:
